ledger.claim: The rider's first burden under POL-RD-08(a) is met on this record: the trip_record, the gps_trace and the fare_breakdown all carry trip_id TRP-00102, and the trace's window (first fix 11:23:30, last fix 11:55:30) sits inside the trip_record's started_at (11:23:30) and ended_at (11:55:30). The three artifacts describe one and the same trip and are fit to be measured against each other.

The distance that governs the threshold is the trace figure, not the rounded copy on the trip record. POL-RD-01 makes gps_trace.trace_distance_km the governing field and expressly forbids citing trip_record.actual_distance_km for the threshold test; here the trace records 21.79 km over 193 fixes at a 10-second sample interval, 100% coverage and a largest gap of 0 seconds. The trace is not impaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07(a) to (c), so no corroboration requirement is engaged and the measurement stands at full weight.

The only in-app message on this trip is the driver's own, sent 11:29:04, delivered 11:29:05, read 11:29:40 and never answered by the rider. POL-RD-04 exonerates a deviation only where the instruction comes from the rider; a driver's request for leave is not a rider instruction, the message carries waypoint_hint null, and it names no road with the specificity the clause demands. POL-RD-04 is therefore unavailable to the driver and no part of the excess is excluded on that footing.

The driver's explanation for the routing - a slow crawl on the BKE near Dairy Farm - is an asserted external traffic cause, and POL-RD-13 requires it to be tested against the traffic_advisory for this trip and nothing else. The only advisory artifact in the bundle, EV-ADVIS-00102-01, is MISSING: its admissibility status is MISSING, its issue code is MISSING_ARTIFACT, its weight_multiplier is 0.0 and it carries no payload. The comparison POL-RD-03 requires - an advisory naming a road the optimal route traverses, with a validity window overlapping the trace, matched by a route that leaves and rejoins the corridor - cannot be run, POL-RD-03 is unavailable, and under POL-RD-08 the assertion carries no weight: it neither reduces the measured excess nor supplies an amended optimal route.

The rider states the arithmetic against himself, because the governing trace will not carry the claim. Measured on the POL-RD-01 fields, 21.79 km actual less 20.4 km optimal is an excess of 1.39 km, which is 6.81% of the optimal distance. That clears the absolute limb (greater than 0.8 km) but fails the proportional limb (greater than 20% of optimal_distance_km), and POL-RD-01 requires both tests to pass. No route deviation is established on this record, the rider does not ask the tribunal to treat this trip as a deviation, and the excess is conceded rather than stretched.

The last route left open once the establishment test fails is the billing-integrity carve-out POL-RD-01 preserves in POL-RD-09(4), and the rider has checked it and reports it empty on this trip. The fare_breakdown itemises no gantry lines at all (erp_gantries empty, tolls_erp 0.00, off-optimal-route ERP total 0.00), the airport surcharge is 0.00 on a trip that neither originates nor ends at an airport, and the base fare (3.80), distance (16.35), time (8.96) and platform fee (0.80) lines reconcile to the metered rate card to the cent against total_charged 29.91. There is no phantom charge for the tribunal to correct.

No route deviation exists on this trip. POL-RD-01 makes gps_trace.trace_distance_km the governing measurement and requires BOTH establishment tests to pass — an excess greater than 20% of optimal_distance_km AND greater than 0.8 km. The trace's own derived deviation block records an excess of 1.39 km, which is 6.81% of the 20.4 km optimal, well short of the 20% gate. The percentage limb fails, so no deviation is established and the outcome is NO_ACTION however the rider characterises the trip.

The threshold test runs on the trace figure, not the trip record's rounded copy. POL-RD-01 provides that where gps_trace.trace_distance_km and trip_record.actual_distance_km disagree the trace governs and the trip record figure 'may NOT be cited for the threshold test'. The trace measures 21.79 km against a 20.4 km optimal — an excess of 1.39 km — and the rounded 21.8 km convenience copy changes nothing, because it is the percentage limb (6.81% against 20%) that fails, not the absolute one.

The rider carries the initial burden and has not discharged it. Under POL-RD-08 she must show an excess meeting the POL-RD-01 threshold, measured from an unimpaired gps_trace. She filed on the trace, and that trace yields 6.81% against a 20% gate. With the initial burden unmet, no exculpatory clause needs to be reached and no burden shifts to the driver.

The trace is unimpaired for policy purposes, so the measurement is final and cannot be escaped into escalation. EV-GPS-00102 is COMPLETE at weight 1.0, with 100% coverage, a 10-second sampling interval against a 10-second expected interval, no gaps and a maximum gap of 0 seconds, so limbs (a) to (c) of POL-RD-07 never fire, no independent corroboration under POL-RD-07(ii) is required, and POL-RD-10(3) is not available as a route around the failed threshold.

There is no billing-integrity refund to set against the driver. POL-RD-01 preserves a POL-RD-09(4) refund whether or not a deviation exists, but this fare carries no ERP or toll gantry lines at all — erp_gantries is empty and both the on-optimal-route and off-optimal-route totals are 0.00 — and no airport surcharge line, on a trip that neither originates nor ends at an airport. No unmatched charge line exists to refund, so the residual remedy POL-RD-01 leaves open yields the rider nothing.

The driver's traffic explanation does not put this case on the escalation track. He cited no advisory evidence ID, and the bundle holds no advisory: EV-ADVIS-00102-01 is MISSING with weight 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT. Under POL-RD-13(1) an assertion that cites no artifact cannot be invoked against one, so the absent advisory is a gap in the bundle rather than a contradiction in it and POL-RD-10(5) is not engaged. POL-RD-03 consequently cannot be run and there is no exoneration to be had — but none is needed, because with the POL-RD-01 threshold failed the driver need not explain the route at all, and the case is decided on the merits rather than escalated.

On a rider-filed dispute where the charge still stands — payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00 — NO_ACTION is the outcome the driver is entitled to. POL-GEN-03 defines NO_ACTION as leaving the present payment state as it is, which here means the metered fare of SGD 29.91 the rider paid stays with the driver and no part of the SGD 7.00 she contested is returned.

ruling.explanation:
Both parties' accounts point the same way, and the record decides the case.

Measuring the trip. The fare is metered (EV-FARE-00102, fare_model METERED), so the route-deviation rules apply. POL-RD-01 requires BOTH establishment tests to pass: an excess greater than 0.8 km AND greater than 20% of the optimal distance. The GPS trace (EV-GPS-00102) is unbroken — 193 fixes, 10-second sampling against a 10-second expected interval, 100% coverage, no gaps, largest gap 0 seconds — and it measures 21.79 km over the trace polyline (the governing field; the trip record's rounded 21.8 km convenience copy may not be cited for the test). The platform's optimal distance is 20.4 km (EV-TRIP-00102). The excess is therefore 1.39 km, which is 6.81% of 20.4 km. It clears the absolute limb (1.39 km > 0.8 km) but fails the proportional limb (6.81%, well short of 20%). Both tests must pass, so no route deviation is established. The metered fare of SGD 29.91 that the rider paid stands; no part of the SGD 7.00 she contested is returned, and payment_status CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.00 is left as it is. POL-RD-02 does not run: its recomputation (which would give 27.46 and a 2.45 difference) applies only once a deviation is established, and none is. Both advocates read the arithmetic to the same conclusion and every claim on this point is accepted.

Why the driver's traffic excuse neither helps nor escalates. The driver's explanation — a slow crawl on the BKE near Dairy Farm — is an asserted external traffic cause, tested under POL-RD-13 against a traffic advisory for this trip and nothing else. The only advisory artifact in the bundle, EV-ADVIS-00102-01, is MISSING: weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, no payload, no coverage of the BKE or the Upper Bukit Timah corridor in the 11:16–11:55 window. The comparison POL-RD-03 requires cannot be run, POL-RD-03 is unavailable, and the assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08. It does not excuse anything — but nothing needs excusing, because the threshold already fails on the rider's own evidence. Because the driver named no advisory evidence ID, the absent advisory is a gap in the bundle, not an exculpatory clause invoked against a cited artifact, and POL-RD-10(5) is not engaged.

Rider-requested detour. The only in-app message on this trip is the driver's own (EV-CHAT-00102, 'boss BKE quite jam, i go Upper Bukit Timah ok?', sent 11:29:04, read 11:29:40, never answered). It is not a rider instruction, carries waypoint_hint null and names no road with the specificity POL-RD-04 demands, so POL-RD-04 excludes nothing on the driver's behalf. No distance is excluded and no compensation arises: the rider was billed for 21.8 km against a trace of 21.79 km, so there is no unbilled-distance shortfall to pay under POL-RD-04's compensation limb.

Billing integrity. EV-FARE-00102 itemises no ERP or toll gantry lines (erp_gantries empty, tolls_erp 0.00, on- and off-optimal-route ERP totals 0.00) and no airport surcharge on a trip that neither originates nor ends at an airport. Base fare 3.80, distance 16.35, time 8.96 and platform fee 0.80 reconcile to the metered rate card against the 29.91 charged. There is no phantom charge to refund under POL-RD-09(4), so no billing-integrity referral fires. The trace is unimpaired for policy purposes, so POL-RD-07's corroboration requirement and POL-RD-10(3) are not in play, and none of the POL-RD-06 driver-profile conditions is met (deviation_flags_90d 0), so no conduct referral fires either.

The precedents sharing these clauses (P-0001, P-0002) ended in partial refunds because their excess met the POL-RD-01 threshold; here the 6.81% proportional limb fails, and that is what makes the difference. The monetary effect is nil, below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, and this ruling is provisional — either party may appeal it once within 30 days under POL-GEN-04.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
